"""Create exact final added-file approvals and full delta bindings; no maintained writes."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

from common import (
    DOSSIER,
    ROOT,
    TARGET,
    bind,
    current,
    external_new,
    inventory,
    now,
    read,
    verify,
    write,
)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--baseline", required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--native-completion", required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--completion-archive", required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    mod = current()
    from lineage import verify_native_completion

    completion, assembly, doc, cfg, adoption = verify_native_completion(args.native_completion)
    assert completion["status"] == "saved_review_and_history_checked"
    for key in ["canonical_yaml", "canonical_markdown", "history"]:
        verify(completion[key])
    assert bind(args.baseline) == adoption["baseline"]
    baseline = read(args.baseline)
    assert baseline["head"] == mod.BASE and baseline["tree"] == mod.TREE
    for group in ["records", "pages", "reviews", "history"]:
        for item in baseline[group]:
            mod.verify(ROOT / item["relative_path"], item, allow_symlink=True)
    old = {x["relative_path"]: x for x in baseline["all_maintained_files"]}
    actual = {p: bind(ROOT / p) for p in inventory(ROOT)}
    assert not (set(old) - set(actual)), "Old maintained file missing"
    expected = read(mod.PACKAGE / "expected-changes.json")
    changed_allowed = (
        {r["relative_path"] for r in mod.code_changes()}
        | set(mod.AUTHORITY_FILES.values())
        | set(expected["allowed_generated_paths"])
    )
    changed = [p for p in old if actual[p]["sha256"] != old[p]["sha256"]]
    assert set(changed) <= changed_allowed
    new = sorted(set(actual) - set(old))
    dossier = read(mod.PACKAGE / "dossier-plan.json")
    original_additions = (
        {TARGET}
        | changed_allowed
        | {DOSSIER + "/" + r["destination"] for r in dossier["mappings"]}
        | {DOSSIER + "/archive-map.json", DOSSIER + "/adoption.json"}
    )
    from lineage import verify_completion_archive

    archived = verify_completion_archive(args.completion_archive, args.native_completion)
    assert archived["status"] == "archived" and archived["native_completion"] == bind(
        args.native_completion
    )
    assembly = read(completion["assembly"]["path"])
    verify(assembly["archive_receipt"])
    gate_archive = read(assembly["archive_receipt"]["path"])
    approved_rows = (
        gate_archive["files"]
        + archived["files"]
        + [archived["archive_map"]]
        + [completion[k] for k in ["canonical_yaml", "canonical_markdown", "history"]]
    )
    approved = {}
    for row in approved_rows:
        verify(row)
        rel = str(Path(row["path"]).relative_to(ROOT))
        assert rel not in approved
        approved[rel] = row
    extras = []
    for p in new:
        if p in original_additions:
            continue
        assert p in approved and actual[p]["sha256"] == approved[p]["sha256"], p
        extras.append({"relative_path": p, **actual[p]})
    output = external_new(args.output)
    output.mkdir()
    write(output / "approved-extra-files.json", extras)
    write(
        output / "post-adoption-file-set.json",
        {
            "at": now(),
            "baseline": bind(args.baseline),
            "native_completion": bind(args.native_completion),
            "completion_archive": bind(args.completion_archive),
            "new_files": [{"relative_path": p, **actual[p]} for p in new],
            "changed_files": [
                {"relative_path": p, "before": old[p], "after": actual[p]} for p in changed
            ],
            "removed_files": [],
            "all_current_files": [{"relative_path": p, **actual[p]} for p in sorted(actual)],
            "search_scope": "rg --no-ignore --hidden --follow, only .git/.venv runtime excluded",
            "approval_scope": "Exact added files only. Old files cannot be waived; old "
            "changes remain bounded to accepted code, authority and g"
            "enerated outputs.",
        },
    )
    print(bind(output / "post-adoption-file-set.json"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
